title: A token that refreshes itself
description:
Keep an access token and refresh it shortly before it expires.

```
t=0     new token A (expires at 3600)
t=1000  using A
t=3550  refreshing early (50 s left)
t=3550  new token B (expires at 7150)
```
hints: `if self.token is None or now >= self.expires_at - self.margin:` refresh (lesson 2.02).
requirements: `class TokenStore` with `get(now)` that returns a valid token, refreshing when fewer than 60 seconds are left.
The refresh function is passed in (so a fake one can be used here), and returns `(token, expires_in)`.
Pass `now` in instead of reading the clock, so the code is easy to test.
stretch: If two parts of a program ask at the same moment, refresh only once (a `threading.Lock`).
